1.text: Yongera kwinjira mu isinagogi asangamo umuntu unyunyutse ukuboko,

2.text: bagenza Yesu ngo barebe ko amukiza ku isabato, babone uko bamurega.

3.text: Abwira uwo muntu unyunyutse ukuboko ati “Haguruka uhagarare hagati mu bantu.”

4.text: Arababaza ati “Mbese amategeko yemera ko umuntu akora neza ku isabato cyangwa ko akora nabi, gukiza umuntu cyangwa kumwica?”Baramwihorera.

5.text: Abararanganyamo amaso arakaye, ababazwa n'uko binangiye imitima, abwira uwo muntu ati “Rambura ukuboko kwawe.” Arakurambura kurakira.

6.text: Uwo mwanya Abafarisayo barasohoka, bigīra inama n'Abaherode ngo babone uko bazamwica.

7.text: Maze Yesu n'abigishwa be barahava bajya ku nyanja, abantu benshi baramukurikira bavuye i Galilaya, n'abandi benshi b'i Yudaya

8.text: n'i Yerusalemu, na Idumaya no hakurya ya Yorodani, n'ab'ahahereranye n'i Tiro n'i Sidoni, bumvise ibyo yakoze baza aho ari.

9.text: Abwira abigishwa be kugumisha ubwato butoya hafi, ngo abantu batamubyiga.

10.text: Kuko yakijije benshi, ni cyo cyatumye abari bafite ibyago bose bamugwira ngo bamukoreho.

11.text: Abadayimoni na bo bamubonye bamwikubita imbere, barataka cyane bati “Uri Umwana w'Imana.”

13.text: Bukeye azamuka umusozi, ahamagara abo ashaka baza aho ari.

14.text: Atoranyamo cumi na babiri bo kubana na we, ngo abone uko ajya abatuma kubwiriza abantu ubutumwa,

16.text: Nuko atoranya abo cumi na babiri, Simoni amwita Petero,

17.text: na Yakobo mwene Zebedayo na Yohana mwene se wa Yakobo na bo abita Bowanerige, risobanurwa ngo “Abana b'inkuba”,

18.text: na Andereya na Filipo, na Barutolomayo na Matayo, na Toma na Yakobo mwene Alufayo, na Tadayo na Simoni Zeloti,

19.text: na Yuda Isikariyota ari we wamugambaniye.

20.text: Ajya iwabo abantu benshi bongera guterana, bituma babura uko bafungura.

21.text: Nuko ab'iwabo babyumvise barasohoka ngo bamufate, kuko bagiraga ngo yasaze.

22.text: Kandi abanditsi bavuye i Yerusalemu na bo bati “Afite Belizebuli”, kandi bati “Umukuru w'abadayimoni ni we umuha kwirukana abadayimoni.”

23.text: Arabahamagara abacira imigani ati “Satani abasha ate kwirukana Satani?

24.text: Iyo ubwami bwigabanyije ubwabwo, ubwo bwami ntibubasha kugumaho.

25.text: Inzu iyo yigabanyije ubwayo ntibasha kugumaho,

26.text: cyangwa Satani iyo yihagurukiye akīgabanya, ntabasha kugumaho ashiraho.

27.text: “Kandi nta muntu wabasha kwinjira mu nzu y'umunyamaboko, ngo amusahure ibintu atabanje kumuboha, kuko ari bwo yabona uko asahura inzu ye.

28.text: “Ndababwira ukuri yuko abantu bazababarirwa ibyaha byabo byose, n'ibitutsi batuka Imana,

29.text: ariko umuntu wese utuka Umwuka Wera ntabwo azabibabarirwa rwose, ahubwo aba akoze icyaha cy'iteka ryose.”

30.text: Icyatumye avuga atyo ni uko bavuze ngo afite dayimoni.

31.text: Maze nyina na bene se baraza, bamutumaho ngo aze bahagaze hanze.

32.text: Abantu benshi bari bicaye bamugose, baramubwira bati “Nyoko na bene so bari hanze baragushaka.”

33.text: Na we arababaza ati “Mama ni nde, na bene data ni bande?”

34.text: Abararanganyamo amaso, abari bicaye impande zose bamugose arababwira ati “Dore mama na bene data:

35.text: umuntu wese ukora ibyo Imana ishaka ni we mwene data, ni we mushiki wanjye, ni we mama.”
